copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会获得 Webex 频道支持:机器人可以加入 Webex 的“空间”(群聊或私聊),接收消息并回复。技能会自动复制适配器代码、注册、安装依赖并运行验证测试。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 Webex,让机器人在 Webex 空间里收发消息时,就会使用这个技能。常见于运行 /setup 或 /manage-channels 流程中。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Webex 频道
say.note: 自动复制适配器、注册并安装依赖

say.text: 我要让机器人能在 Webex 里聊天
say.note: 会配置 Webex bot 和 webhook 凭据

say.text: 把 Webex 接入我的 NanoClaw 机器人
say.note: 执行技能并提示你完成 bot 创建

howto.what_en: Adds Webex channel support to NanoClaw: the bot can join Webex spaces, receive messages, and reply. It copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dependency, and runs a validation test.
howto.when_en: Used when you want to connect NanoClaw to Webex so the bot can chat in Webex spaces. Typically triggered during /setup or /manage-channels flows.

say_en.text: Let my bot chat in Webex spaces
say_en.note: Sets up Webex bot and webhook credentials

say_en.text: Hook Webex up to my NanoClaw bot
say_en.note: Runs skill and guides bot creation
